description: A valid theme manifest declares light mode as the base, has surface and text tokens, maps all tokens per mode, and maintains token name stability across modes.

rules.description: Light mode must always be declared. It is the universal fallback for systems that do not support prefers-color-scheme and the baseline for all mode derivations.
A meaningful theme system requires at least 10 semantic tokens: surface, text, border, interactive, destructive, success, warning, info, disabled, and focus are the minimum viable set.
At least one surface token and one text/fg/foreground token must be declared. Without these, components cannot establish basic visual layering.
Every mode declared in the modes array must have a corresponding entry in the mappings object. A declared mode with no mapping is a broken theme variant.
